messages:
Nina: Quick ask - Prospect Solace wants a Private/VPC POC next week. Hard req: SAML assertions must never transit the public internet, they prefer IPv6 for client-facing traffic, and they want a short non-technical memo PrivateLink vs Peering for their security reviewers. Can NetOps + Sec advise?

Omar: TL;DR: PrivateLink = endpoint isolation + much narrower firewall allowlist and no cross-account route injection. VPC Peering = cheaper (no connector surcharge) but gives broader L3 reachability and requires careful route table scoping. If SAML absolutely cannot leave their network, recommend either Private deployment or run a tiny SAML-proxy in their VPC that forwards over PrivateLink.

Priya: IPv6 callout: our hosted PrivateLink connector currently speaks IPv4 only. We can support IPv6 client traffic by recommending a customer-side NAT64/DNS64 or an IPv6-to-IPv4 gateway. Native IPv6 for the connector is not GA yet; flag as a blocker if they insist on native v6 for model-serving traffic. Control-plane (SAML) can be proxied over IPv4 PrivateLink via the bridge.

Omar: Minimal firewall allowlist (example CIDRs, will supply exact list):
```
# Outbound from customer app/subnets -> Redwood PrivateLink endpoints
TCP 443 -> 34.201.128.0/22   # control-plane callbacks / auth
TCP 443 -> 52.204.64.0/22    # model-serving endpoints (hosted)
# Optional: ICMP echo to 34.201.128.0/22 for health checks
# If they require static egress IPs: allow TCP 443 from our EIP pool (we will share exact IPs)
```

Priya: TLS inspection note: If customer does TLS MITM/SNI inspection, they must either allow SNI passthrough for our hostnames or install our CA cert on the inspection appliance; otherwise SAML POSTbacks and mutual TLS handshakes may fail. Also confirm they accept TLS1.2+ and modern ciphers.

Nina: Pricing question from buyer: is there an extra connector fee for PrivateLink and per-GB egress?

Omar: Short answer: hosted PrivateLink connector has a monthly connector surcharge + per-GB egress billing. Private deployment is a separate licensing model (platform fee + support). I'll paste the exact pricing line after the call.

Priya: POC preflight checklist we can hand to their NetOps: 1) Provide a VPC (/20 recommended) or designate existing VPC with spare private subnets. 2) Reserve two private subnets for connector components (no public IPs required). 3) Pre-authorize outbound HTTPS to our control-plane CIDRs (we'll provide exact ranges). 4) If IPv6 required for client traffic: deploy NAT64/DNS64 or an IPv6-to-IPv4 translation gateway and validate with our test endpoints. 5) If SAML must remain private-only: deploy a small SAML bridge VM in their VPC that proxies assertions to our control plane over PrivateLink. 6) Optionally request static egress EIPs for callbacks/IdP ACLs  we will share EIP list.

sec-bot: FYI - Prospect checked the box "no shared IPs". PrivateLink provides per-endpoint isolation but does not guarantee single-tenant hardware. If they require physical/dedicated hosts, open a dedicated-hosting request/ticket. :lock:

Nina: Can NetOps + Sec join a 4pm PT sync today? Need a one-page justification memo + firewall snippet to hand to the buyer before the POC.

Omar: 4pm works for me. I'll bring exact connector CIDRs and sample route table snippets.

Priya: In. I'll bring NAT64 deployment notes and the TLS/cipher checklist for the security questionnaire.

Nina: Thanks everyone. I'll schedule and share the concise pre-provision checklist after the call. :thumbsup:
